findings.evidence: A harmless custom-element marker was reflected without HTML encoding.
findings.remediation: Encode untrusted output for its HTML context and use safe template rendering.

findings.evidence: A query value matches a common SQL injection pattern; no SQL was executed.
findings.remediation: Use parameterized queries and validate values at the application boundary.

findings.evidence: A state-changing form has no recognized non-empty hidden CSRF token.
findings.remediation: Use a per-session CSRF token and validate it on state-changing requests.

findings.evidence: Parameter value contains a link-local address indicator; no request was made.
findings.remediation: Resolve and validate destinations against an explicit server-side allowlist before fetching.

limitations: Findings are heuristic candidates for manual verification, not proof of exploitability.
The scanner targets loopback only and does not execute payloads or make SSRF requests.
